title: The Task page shows the evidence: pull request, diff, checks, where the time went and the Builder's live session
description: A real control plane on isolated Postgres with a git fixture serves a task's trial step timings from the merge ledger (one file taking 14 of 19 minutes), its changed files with per-file counts and each file's diff, and the model its Builder's session reported beside the account's. A real browser on the built dashboard at 1280 and 390 px opens a task whose merge trial failed: the header shows title, state with time in state, the pull request link, the Builder's friendly name, the reported model with its mark, diff stats, one action, and the key and commit small, with one sentence why and one on what happens next; the pipeline row shows each stage's time, the total beside the median, the trial's counts and its slowest file; the tabs show checks with the failing output and the diff on click, the Builder's read-only live session and its saved output once ended, the Lead's decisions, and the details; the footer shows the two commands. Typing into the live session sends nothing and no page scrolls sideways.
